title: 第9章 门外第10章 有限的灵气
content_zh:
;;
饭后，收拾完碗筷，窗外已染上暮色。
张唯回到卧室床上，缓缓盘膝坐下，下颌微收，让每一节脊椎都如叠瓦般垂直贯连。
他开始默诵《庄子大宗师》，心绪慢慢沉淀。
无数遍的翻阅，内容已经在他心里滚瓜烂熟。
不一会儿，熟悉的电流麻感自颅底肿瘤泛起，传递神经，他没有抗拒，将其视作荡涤杂念的涟漪。
这也是他能迅速进入坐忘依仗。
眼前彩斑浮动片刻后，骤然沉入无边的黑暗。
绝对的虚无包裹了他的意识，呼吸、心跳、乃至自我的概念都稀薄如烟。
这便是“堕肢体，黜聪明”的坐忘初境。
不多时，那点熟悉的青白微光刺破了深沉的黑暗。
张唯睁开眼，暗沉黑洞洞的环境再次映入眼帘。
冰冷的死寂感瞬间将他包裹，一种混合了铁锈与腐败土腥味的污浊空气钻入他的鼻孔。
让人觉得似乎破败了很久。
依旧是自己居住的房子，只是内景世界中自己的房子太过斑驳，似乎上百年时间都无人居住。
单单待在室内，依旧让张唯感到些许凉意，但很快，他就习惯了这份阴森。
手中的运火灯焰心跃动着青白色的冷光，将昏黄摇曳的光晕勉强撑开周身三尺之地。
光晕之外，黑暗依旧像上次吞噬着光线，三尺之外就看不真切，黑洞洞一片。
尽管已经勉强适应，但这种黑洞洞一片，产生的未知恐怖还是让张唯忍不住心头微跳。
他进入内景世界的这个房间，应该是他的安全屋，大概率暂时不会有其他危险。

张唯提着运火灯，小心翼翼地开始在房间里转圈，灯光照亮之处，依旧是像上一次进来时熟悉的客厅布局。
褪色的沙发轮廓，书柜模糊的影子，墙壁上深褐色污渍。
他穿过熟悉的门廊走向厨房，地板上覆盖着厚厚的灰尘，脚步无声，却能感觉到脚下粉质的触感。
卧室的门紧闭着，一靠近，运火灯光从门缝中渗入少许，里面同样幽暗。
卫生间的门半开着，盥洗台上残留的水垢在昏黄灯光下折射出油腻的光泽。
冰箱门歪斜着，缝隙漆黑。
一切都像上次一样。
张唯轻呼了口气，略微放下心来。
内景世界中的客厅、卧室、厨房、卫生间，格局是他住了十几年的家，但都被笼罩在极其陈腐破败的氛围中，仿佛经历了很久很久的岁月侵蚀。
最后，张唯还是将注意力放在了通往外界走廊的那扇老式防盗门上。
门上那褪色的倒贴福字依旧在。
走上前去，运火灯光只能照亮门内有限的范围。
张唯屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地靠近，将眼睛贴在防盗门猫眼上。
猫眼的视角狭窄扭曲。
透过它看去，走廊依旧一片死寂的黑洞洞，之前堵门的那女鬼似乎已经消失不见，似乎看起来安全了。
啧。
其实那女鬼体态起码挺好的。
冷静下来的张唯甚至还有闲情腹诽了几句。
真遇到他也不高兴。

After dinner, after clearing away the dishes, twilight has already fallen outside the window.
Zhang Wei returned to the bed in the bedroom, slowly sat down cross-legged, and slightly retracted his chin so that each vertebrae was connected vertically like tiles.
He began to recite "The Great Master Zhuangzi" silently, and his mind slowly settled.
After reading it countless times, the content was already familiar to him.
After a while, the familiar numbness of electricity emerged from the tumor at the base of his skull and was transmitted to his nerves. He did not resist and regarded it as a ripple that washed away distracting thoughts.
This is also the reason why he can quickly enter into oblivion.
The colorful spots in front of his eyes floated for a moment, then suddenly sank into boundless darkness.
Absolute nothingness enveloped his consciousness, and his breathing, heartbeat, and even the concept of self were as thin as smoke.
This is the original state of sitting and forgetting "the limbs are dropped and the intelligence is deposed".
Not long after, that familiar green-white glimmer pierced the deep darkness.
Zhang Wei opened his eyes, and the dark and dark environment came into view again.
A cold sense of death instantly enveloped him, and a filthy air mixed with the smell of rust and decaying earth penetrated his nostrils.
It feels like it has been dilapidated for a long time.
It is still the house where I live, but my house in the interior world is too mottled, as if no one has lived in it for hundreds of years.
Just staying indoors still made Zhang Wei feel a little chilly, but he soon got used to the gloominess.
The heart of the flame of the transporting fire lantern in his hand danced with blue-white cold light, barely extending the dim and swaying halo three feet around him.
Outside the halo, the darkness is still swallowing up the light like last time. It is impossible to see clearly from three feet away, and it is a black hole.
Although he had barely adapted to it, the unknown terror caused by this black hole still made Zhang Wei's heart beat slightly.
The room he entered in the interior world should be his safe house, and there is a high probability that there will be no other dangers for the time being.
Zhang Wei held the fire lantern and carefully began to circle around the room. The place illuminated by the light was still the familiar layout of the living room when he came in last time.
The faded outline of the sofa, the blurred shadow of the bookcase, and the dark brown stains on the wall.
He walked through the familiar hallway to the kitchen. The floor was covered with thick dust. His footsteps were silent, but he could feel the powdery touch under his feet.
The door to the bedroom was closed tightly. As soon as I got closer, a little light from the firelight seeped through the cracks in the door, and it was equally dark inside.
The bathroom door was half open, and the scale remaining on the washbasin reflected a greasy sheen under the dim light.
The refrigerator door was crooked and the gap was dark.
Everything is the same as last time.
Zhang Wei took a breath and felt slightly relieved.
The layout of the living room, bedroom, kitchen, and bathroom in the interior world is that of the home where he has lived for more than ten years, but they are all shrouded in an extremely outdated and dilapidated atmosphere, as if they have experienced the erosion of time for a long time.
In the end, Zhang Wei focused on the old-fashioned security door leading to the corridor outside.
The faded word "福" posted upside down on the door is still there.
Walking forward, the firelight can only illuminate a limited area inside the door.
Zhang Wei held his breath, approached cautiously, and put his eyes on the peephole of the security door.
Cat's Eye has a narrow and distorted perspective.
Looking through it, the corridor is still a dead black hole. The female ghost who blocked the door before seems to have disappeared, and it seems to be safe.
Tsk.
In fact, the female ghost is in good shape at least.
After calming down, Zhang Wei even made some casual remarks.
I'm not happy to meet him either.
